public_rationale: Sora rose to the top of Apple's app store, subsequently recorded declining iOS downloads, and its consumer app was discontinued on April 26, 2026. The completed shutdown after the initial surge meets the early-resolution rule. This supports the ordinary rise-and-fall prediction without requiring a deadline or an exact decline threshold.
limitations: App downloads do not measure continuing engagement.
Android growth initially offset some iOS weakness.
Shutdown establishes the product's fall, but does not establish why it happened or imply failure of all AI video technology.

statement.excerpt: I would bet a lot of money that OpenAI’s Sora 2-driven competitor to TikTok will experience a similar rise and fall.
statement.document_title: Five signs that Generative AI is losing traction

from_speaker: will experience a similar rise and fall
I would bet a lot of money
our_interpretation: The target is the Sora consumer social-video app, rather than the underlying model or all AI video generation.
Rise and fall means an initial adoption surge followed by a substantial, sustained decline in adoption or use.
Permanent discontinuation after an initial adoption surge conclusively establishes the app's fall.
The betting language expresses confidence, not an antecedent that must occur.
No deadline or exact percentage decline is supplied.
criteria.support_condition: Dated evidence establishes an initial adoption surge followed by a substantial sustained decline in comparable adoption or usage measures, or permanent discontinuation of the consumer app.
criteria.contradiction_condition: A definitive completed product history shows that the predicted rise-and-fall sequence never occurred. Continued growth for a limited interval cannot contradict this undated forecast.

evidence.excerpt: The app quickly jumped to the top of Apple's app store.
evidence.locator: Paragraph following the description of the September 2025 Sora 2 release
evidence.explanation: This establishes the initial rise in popularity. Reputable reporting is used because a readable primary tracker record was not obtained.

evidence.locator: Appfigures discussion, paragraph beginning 'The iOS version launched'
evidence.explanation: The comparable iOS series shows declining monthly downloads. The same report records increasing Android downloads over those months, so the iOS decline alone does not establish an equally large decline across both platforms.

evidence.excerpt: The Sora web and app experiences were discontinued on April 26, 2026.
evidence.explanation: OpenAI confirms the completed shutdown of the claimed consumer product. The retrieved notice was updated on the evaluation date; its stated shutdown date supplies the decisive event.

conclusive_event.meets_rule: The official completed consumer-app shutdown followed the documented initial adoption surge.
